words.definition: the combining of two or more companies into one
words.example: The merger between the two firms was announced this morning.
words.exampleTranslation: 這兩家公司的合併案於今早正式公布。
words.note: 動詞形 merge (v.) 合併，例如 merge the two departments。

words.definition: a team sport played by kicking a ball into a goal
words.example: The office hosts a friendly soccer match every summer.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司每年夏天都會舉辦友誼足球賽。
words.note: 美式英文用 soccer，英式英文通常說 football

words.definition: a knitted garment worn on the upper body
words.example: Bring a sweater; the conference room tends to be cold.
words.exampleTranslation: 帶件毛衣吧，會議室通常都很冷。
words.note: 美式英文用 sweater，英式（及澳式）英文常說 jumper

words.definition: one of the items used to make a food dish
words.example: The recipe lists every ingredient needed for the banquet menu.
words.exampleTranslation: 這份食譜列出了宴會菜單所需的每一項食材。
words.note: 常用片語 secret ingredient（獨門秘方；成功的關鍵要素）

words.definition: to write something again, usually to improve or correct it
words.example: Please rewrite the summary so it's easier to understand.
words.exampleTranslation: 請把摘要改寫得更容易理解。
words.note: 不規則動詞變化：rewrite–rewrote–rewritten

words.definition: a planned route or schedule for a trip
words.example: Your travel itinerary includes two connecting flights.
words.exampleTranslation: 你的旅行行程表包含兩段轉機航班。
words.note: 常用片語 draw up an itinerary（擬定行程表）

words.definition: a place where people work, such as an office or factory
words.example: The survey measures employee satisfaction in the workplace.
words.exampleTranslation: 這份調查用來衡量員工在職場中的滿意度。
words.note: 常見於 workplace safety（職場安全）這個複合詞

words.definition: a person who designs buildings and oversees their construction
words.example: The architect presented three design options for the new office.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位建築師為新辦公室提出了三個設計方案。
words.note: 名詞形 architecture (n.) 建築；建築學，例如 study architecture at university。

words.definition: the quality of being easy to use or suited to one's needs
words.example: For your convenience, online check-in opens twenty-four hours before departure.
words.exampleTranslation: 為了您的便利，線上報到在出發前二十四小時開放。
words.note: 常用片語 at your earliest convenience（請儘早，正式書信用語）

words.definition: having the right to be included in or considered for something
words.example: Employees are eligible for the bonus after one year of service.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工任職滿一年後就有資格領取獎金。
words.note: 後接名詞用 eligible for，後接動詞用 eligible to，例如 eligible to vote

words.definition: located, happening, or used inside a building
words.example: The reception will move to the indoor hall if it rains.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果下雨，接待會就會移到室內大廳舉行。
words.note: 反義詞：outdoor（戶外的）

words.definition: bags and suitcases carried while traveling
words.example: Passengers can check two pieces of baggage for free.
words.exampleTranslation: 乘客可以免費託運兩件行李。
words.note: 不可數名詞，沒有複數形 baggages，同義詞為 luggage

words.definition: to press buttons or turn a device to make a phone call
words.example: Dial nine to reach an outside line from your office phone.
words.exampleTranslation: 從辦公室電話撥打外線請先撥九。
words.note: 常見於 dial tone（撥號音）這個複合詞

words.definition: an object used to hold or transport goods
words.example: The shipment will arrive in a single sea container next week.
words.exampleTranslation: 這批貨會在下週以一個海運貨櫃運抵。
words.note: 常見於 shipping container（貨櫃）這個複合詞

words.definition: a sliding storage compartment in a desk or cabinet
words.example: Extra pens and paper clips are kept in the bottom drawer.
words.exampleTranslation: 多的筆和迴紋針放在最下面的抽屜裡。
words.note: 常見於 chest of drawers（五斗櫃）這個固定用法

words.definition: a room or building equipped for scientific research or testing (short for laboratory)
words.example: Samples are sent to the lab for quality testing.
words.exampleTranslation: 樣品會被送到實驗室做品質檢測。
words.note: 口語簡稱，正式書面較常用完整說法 laboratory

words.definition: the act of presenting something, such as a document, for consideration
words.example: The submission deadline for conference proposals is next Friday.
words.exampleTranslation: 研討會提案的提交截止日是下週五。
words.note: 動詞形 submit (v.) 提交，例如 submit the report by Friday。

words.definition: a short official statement or announcement
words.example: A bulletin was posted about the upcoming office closure.
words.exampleTranslation: 有一則關於辦公室即將休館的公告已張貼出來。
words.note: 常見於 bulletin board（佈告欄）這個複合詞

words.definition: a place equipped for physical exercise and training (short for gymnasium)
words.example: The hotel gym is open twenty-four hours for guests.
words.exampleTranslation: 飯店的健身房全天二十四小時開放給住客使用。
words.note: 常用片語 hit the gym（去健身房運動），口語說法

words.definition: a main public road connecting towns or cities
words.example: Expect heavy traffic on the highway during rush hour.
words.exampleTranslation: 尖峰時段公路上預期會有大量車流。
words.note: 常用片語 highway robbery（獅子大開口，指價格過高）
